I went from complete noob to humbly designing this site in only months. These are the tools I use.

  • Firefox and other browsers.

    I use Firefox as my main development utility. I also have Internet Explorer, Chromium, and Opera to test how a webpage looks across different browsers.

  • A text editor.

    I use Sublime Text, but any good text editor will do.

  • Firebug extension for Firefox.

    This is the main beef of development. This extension is the best interface for inspecting a webpage and creating custom CSS. I don't think I can call myself a web designer without it.

  • Subverses/subreddits.

    Come over to /v/CSS with any questions and we'll take care of you. Also, check out the /r/web_design subreddit on Reddit for a treasure of information on CSS.
